description: x-lookup is a read-only browser for public X/Twitter content, returning posts, threads, profiles, search results, followers, and following as Markdown or JSON. It uses public upstream sources and does not access private or gated content.
summary: Public no-auth integration surface with one OpenAPI-documented HTTP API at `https://x-lookup.mynameistito.com` and one streamable-HTTP MCP server at `https://x-lookup.mynameistito.com/mcp`.
